name: Rogueblox
desc:
> Rogueblox is extremely difficult and requires heavy perseverance.

Set out on a journey into the world of Rogueblox!
In a land marred by war, you and your fellow adventurers will pick up the pieces of a fractured world.
Train under a diverse cast of 20+ masters to unlock powerful classes and claw your way to the top. Fight monsters, loot dungeons, challenge bosses and defeat other players to discover new armor, weapons and 70+ relics that allow you to customize your build in unique ways.
Leave your mark on the world of Terra!

- Created by Ssserpent Ssstudios. Credits can be viewed in the title screen.
